title: Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making

pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 10.2.1 STUDY SKILLS: NOTE MAKING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.2: Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is the importance of note- making in reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main and supporting points in texts

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main and supporting points in texts
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main and supporting points in texts. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making.
4. Show that you can: identify the main and supporting points in texts

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 10.2.1 Study Skills: Note Making important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the importance of note making in reading,
2. Read texts on varied issues, including music, and select the key points,
3. Collaborate with peers to draw a mind map to show the relationship between the topic, main idea, and supporting ideas,
4. Digital literacy: It is enhanced as the learner uses digital devices to search online for information on note-making.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main and supporting points in texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
